title: Selected Stories (1968-1994)

sensory: a whole life in a few pages
vibeProfile.oneLine: Three decades of Alice Munro, who fits whole lives into single stories.

summary: The first volume of a career-spanning selection from Alice Munro, the Nobel laureate widely regarded as one of the greatest short-story writers who ever lived. Set mostly in small-town Ontario, her stories compress whole lives, marriages and secret turning points into a few luminous pages, with a novelist's depth and a poet's economy. Quiet on the surface and devastating underneath, they reward slow reading. This gathering shows the first three decades of a quiet master at work.
whyReadIt: The quiet master of the short story, first three decades. Munro compresses whole lives into a few devastating pages.

funFacts.text: Munro won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2013, cited as a 'master of the contemporary short story'.
